information.description:
The Copernicus's younger sibling, tuned in the 2050s for long-haul pilots, research ships and combat craft. It can work alone for years and outfly anyone in the solar system. Reports say a group of Galileos stole an experimental ship in 2067 and vanished. Nobody's proven it.

Cost: 23,450eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 61 ([2d6/2 Round Up] + 17d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: MonoVision
Base chrome (no HL): Neuroport (w/ Feedback Circuit)
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle, Bodyweight Autoinjector, FBC EMP Coating, Hello Cutie Sparkle-Ize, Image Enhance, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade, (-1d6 Humanity Loss) Mechatronic Core, Prehensile Cyberfoot ×2, (-1d6 Humanity Loss) Radar/Sonar Implant, Radio Communicator, (-1d6 Humanity Loss) Techscanner, Toolhand ×2, Zero Gravity Thrusters ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
